items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And he was having groups there like Billy Tolles, and the local guys were playing.

ctx.x: And he was having groups there like Billy Tolles, and the local guys were playing. And it had more...it had some fire to it. It wasn't necessarily that there were any...that those guys were so far out with their jazz things, but they had more fire and I wanted to...
They had a pretty strong rhythm and blues feeling, didn't they?
